notes.title: New Level: Ultimate Leaderboard Challenge
notes.content:
Calling all Racers -

As competition heats up on the leaderboards, we introduce one last ultimate challenge level featuring some of the fastest cars and a difficult track.

Think you have what it takes to be the best? The [b]top 10[/b] players on the leaderboard by the end of the Steam Next Fest will be [b]permanently featured[/b] on our website!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718521/89289c1e4858c9c0f93f55ffa6781e301a936354.png[/img]

Also join us on Steam for our live stream, where the developers play [i]Delivery Missions[/i], a special game mode featuring fully procedurally generated levels and explore offroad in some of the maps!

See you on the tracks in [i]Rogue Racer[/i]!

[h1]Wishlist now![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/764420/Rogue_Racer/
